title: Honey Flatbread with Greek Spread
description: A sweet and savory flatbread topped with a delicious Greek spread made with honey.
instructions: Brush flatbread with kissed olive oil.
Bake flatbread in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together Greek honey and feta cheese.
Once flatbread is done, remove from oven and let cool for a minute.
Spread the honey-feta mixture onto the flatbread.
